_help: Copy to settings.json (setup does this for you) and edit. Restart the display after a change. Any setting left out uses the default in server.py.
_agenda_help: Paste your calendar's private ICS link between the quotes, e.g. ["https://<lpm-host>/calendar/feed/<token>.ics"]. Add more links separated by commas. Leave [] to turn the agenda off.
_nyt_help: Optional: your NYT sign-in cookie (NYT-S), so headlines open in full in the reading panel. See README, 'Reading full NYT articles'. Secret.
_screensaver_help: Screen saver mode only (start-screensaver.bat): minutes without mouse or keyboard input before the display appears, and whether closing it locks Windows.
_screens_help: Screen saver on a laptop with a monitor plugged in: "external" shows it only on the monitor and turns the laptop screen's brightness down while it shows; "all" uses every screen. keep_pc_awake: true stops the PC from sleeping and keeps the screens on while the display shows.
_screen_help: The name this PC's screen has in the Display Manager app. Leave empty to use the PC's name.
_assistant_help: Voice assistant for the iPad app. anthropic_api_key: a Claude API key from console.anthropic.com (secret; empty = assistant off). It stops for the month once it has spent assistant_monthly_usd dollars, and answers at most assistant_daily_requests requests a day. See README, 'The iPad app and its voice assistant'.
_menuapp_help: Optional: MenuApp's display URL (MenuApp, Settings, Kitchen Display, Copy Display URL), so spoken shopping items also reach MenuApp's Grocery tab. Secret.
_announce_help: Optional: also send announcements ('tell everyone dinner is ready') to phones and tablets. Install the free ntfy app on each device, subscribe to a long made-up topic name, and put https://ntfy.sh/<that name> here. Secret.
_apns_help: Optional: announcements as spoken notifications on the family's iPhones and iPads that have the Shabbat Display app, even while it is closed. In the Apple developer account make a key (Keys, tick Apple Push Notifications), save the .p8 file on this computer, and give its path, the key's ID and the team ID here. The key file is secret.
_apns_critical_help: Leave false unless Apple has granted the app Critical Alerts and that build is on the devices. True makes announcements sound through silent mode.
